Health x technology: Magnetic stimulation activates neurons to target depression
Brain stimulation has helped depression patients for years, yet only a small minority can access the therapy. Researchers are now making it easier, faster, and more personalised.
13.10.2026

Maarit Karppinen appointed Academician of Science
Fundamental research into new materials is at the heart of Karppinen’s work. What she is most proud of is her students, whose expertise benefits companies and society.
9.10.2026

High‑Up! 2026 – An official Slush side event for high school students
High-Up! is a free two-day innovation event taking place at Aalto University on 19–20 November during Slush week. It brings together 16–18-year-old high school students from across Finland to tackle societal challenges with expert mentors.

Studies and courses open to all
Lifewide Learning
Aalto University Lifewide Learning helps you develop your skills in an ever-changing environment.
Aalto University Open University
Open University courses are open to everyone regardless of background or age. Open University offers individual courses in Business, Technology, Languages, and Art and Design. Students are admitted to individual courses in the order of registration.
Aalto University Junior
Aalto University Junior is art, science, technology and entrepreneurship for children, young people and teachers - to support teaching, personal joy and a source of enthusiasm.

Read about our research and donate
At Aalto University, we create the conditions for innovation, economic growth, employment and wellbeing. A gift to the university is an investment in a better future.
Research & Art
Our research focuses on seven key areas combining four core competences in the fields of digitalisation, materials, arts and design, and business together with three grand challenges related to energy, living environments, and health.
Give for the future
Join us in building a sustainable future! Together we can solve some of the toughest problems of our time.
